lemmas.primary_translation: used when giving someone something or inviting them to help themselves to food or similar things / used to say that one has been forced to do something

definitions.text: brukt når en gir noen noe, oppfordrer til å forsyne seg med mat eller lignende
definitions.translation: used when giving someone something or inviting them to help themselves to food or similar things

examples.no: vær så god å gå til bords
examples.en: please take your seats at the table

examples.no: jeg har en gave til deg. Vær så god
examples.en: I have a gift for you. Here you go

definitions.text: brukt for å si at en har blitt tvunget til noe
definitions.translation: used to say that one has been forced to do something

examples.no: vi måtte vær så god gjøre som han sa
examples.en: we had no choice but to do as he said
